_comment: Unpredictable Cyclone phase 4: Long-Term Plans sets up the walk. Round 3, main 1, land drop made, Cyclone +
three Islands out; Long-Term Plans and Street Wraith in hand. The library top is Curator of Mysteries, two
Islands, then Emrakul. Cycling the Wraith straight away walks to the CURATOR (the first creature) -- no
round-3 kill. The winning line casts Long-Term Plans first (all three Islands) for EMRAKUL: the search
shuffles and puts Emrakul third from the top, so the Wraith's walk (pay 2 life, no mana) passes the two
shuffled cards above it and casts Emrakul free -- an extra turn, Emrakul attacks for 15, and the 15-life
opponent dies in ROUND 3. Needs the SEARCHED tutor target (Emrakul) and the cast-then-cycle order.
